chunks: So Allah sent Muhammad with the Truth,
to take out His servants from the worship of idols to His worship, and from the obedience of Satan to His obedience,
with a Qur'an which He had explained and perfected,
so that the servants may know their Lord when they were ignorant of Him, and acknowledge Him after they had denied Him, and affirm Him after they had rejected Him.
So He, the Glorified, revealed Himself to them in His Book without their having seen Him,
by means of what He showed them of His power, and made them fear His sway,
and how He destroyed those whom He wished to destroy through His chastisements, and reaped those whom He wished to reap through His retributions!
ai.seo_question: How does the Qur'an reveal Allah to humanity according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the core objective of Prophethood as a transition from 'ibadat al-awthan' (worship of idols) to 'ibadat Allah', facilitated by a Qur'an that is both clarified (bayyan) and perfected (ahkam). This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Qur'an as the primary vehicle for 'ma'rifat Allah' (knowing God), where divine attributes are revealed through His signs and power rather than physical sight, establishing a theological framework for understanding divine sovereignty and judgment.

en.sayed-ali-raza: so that he may take out His people from the worship of idols towards His worship and from obeying Satan towards obeying Him
and sent him with the Qur’ān which He explained and made strong,

in order that the people may know their sustainer (Allāh) since they were ignorant of Him, may acknowledge Him since they were denying Him, and accept Him since they were refusing (to believe in) Him.
Because He, the Glorified, revealed Himself to them through His Book without their having seen Him,
by means of what He showed them out of His might and made them fear His sway.
How He destroyed those whom He wished to destroy through His chastisement and ruined those whom He wished to ruin through His retribution !
